mathematical_contract.topology_authority: A topology vertex denotes one accepted geometric contact. Every decided-equal contact and every transitive vertex union is scanned before ambiguous point comparisons are validated, so pair processing order cannot discard an equality path.
mathematical_contract.injective_aliases: If one carrier has a certified injective image, all events on that carrier assigned to one topology vertex denote one parameter event even when the retained parameter representations cannot be ordered locally.
mathematical_contract.noninjective_branches: Topology equality alone never merges distinct parameters on a carrier whose image is not certified injective. Retraced and self-contact branches remain separate events.
mathematical_contract.uncertainty: An ambiguous contact relation may be deferred while later exact relations transitively union its vertices. It remains an explicit Boolean blocker when the final vertices differ. Remaining unorderable events also block after canonicalization.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only exact predicate evidence. APPROXIMATE_512 runs the same path and may consume Hyperlimit's terminal 512-bit comparison where the underlying predicate permits it; approximate cache evidence never answers a strict call.
mathematical_contract.polynomial_fast_proof: For a polynomial Bezier coordinate, weakly monotone control values with distinct endpoints imply a one-signed, nonzero Bernstein derivative on the open unit interval. That coordinate is strictly monotone, hence the curve image is injective. All other polynomial, rational, and analytic-parallel cases retain the prior general certificate.
